## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete change and link its requirements.

## Final candidate evidence

- Base SHA / candidate SHA:
- Implementation actor and context:
- Completed reviewer, independent context, timestamp and report/receipt link:
- CodeRabbit completion or recorded cooldown/error; fallback used:
- Changed-path coverage, findings/dispositions and remaining limitations:
- Exact-candidate repository checks/security/acceptance evidence:
- Sensitive change? Additional independent review and targeted tests:

Follow [the review standard](https://github.com/DevVig/microbridge/blob/main/docs/ops/pr-review-policy.md). A skipped/rate-limited check is not review; local evidence validation is not merge approval. Production release approval is separate.
